summary: Shared change (client UI flow). Table clicks, phase 2. The first click on one of your cards in play (Personality, Holding, Stronghold, Ring, attached card, Region, Celestial) starts its ability when exactly one ability can be used now and nothing about who performs it is left to choose; hovering still inspects. A card with several usable abilities, several possible performers, an action lock or a pending decision keeps today's behaviour (select and list). Adds tools/check-table-click-ui.sh (Agasha Kodo, Komori Taruko, Akodo's Guidance, a no-ability control, and an out-of-turn control). Existing native checks whose expectations followed the old two-step flow are updated (province-target Shrine, decision-chooser Fukui, stabilization equip). Client only.
validation: Native: new tools/check-table-click-ui.sh passes; check-direct-play-ui, check-province-target-ui, check-decision-chooser, check-stabilization, check-permanent-grants (one earlier screenshot-comparison failure did not reproduce), check-card-deselection, check-multi-targets-ui, check-attack-targets-ui, check-reaction-flow-ui, check-interactions, check-movement-ui, check-gold-payment, check-board-ui, check-bowed-unit, check-card-clarity, check-copy-ui, check-created-copies-ui, check-opponent-payment-ui, check-unit-standard, check-event-decisions, check-either-or-ui pass. Failing before this change and unrelated: check-action-lock-ui and check-battle-sequence-ui (also fail at the commit before phase 1), check-support-cards (Projected Region inspection), check-persistent-home (reflection AmbiguousMatchException on Choose). Native UI checks are not run in CI.
remaining: Phases 3 to 10 of the table-click plan. A card with several usable abilities still lists them in the sidebar; performers of an in-play source are chosen from sidebar buttons until phase 3.
